_meta.description: Labeled dataset for Phase 2 Part 2 Complexity Classification training and evaluation.
_meta.note: Labels are manually assigned based on expected reasoning depth, multi-step processing, and domain knowledge required. This dataset is intentionally separate from benchmarks/prompts.json to prevent train/test leakage.
_meta.split: All 90 samples are available for training/evaluation. Classifiers use 70/30 train-test splits during evaluation.
